note: Every address this site has published. Append-only: a row is never removed and its path never changes. Kinds: surface, leaf, record, redirect (with its target in "to"), gone (with the commit that removed it). scripts/build-addresses.mjs checks it and adds a row for a new page; tests/test_no_dead_address.py fails if an address stops answering.
projectSitesNote: Other repositories publish their own pages under these prefixes of this host. They are live and none of their files are in this repository, so a link or a redirect into one is accepted without a row. /cmmns/ and /flywheel/ answered on 2026-11-13; /buildlang/ answered with a page that sends readers to /buildlang.html.
